blocks.translation: # 第 13 章　积分

blocks.source: The derivative does not display its full strength until allied with the “integral,” the second main concept of Part III. At first this topic may seem to be a complete digression—in this chapter derivatives do not appear even once! The study of integrals does require a long preparation, but once this preliminary work has been completed, integrals will be an invaluable tool for creating new functions, and the derivative will reappear in Chapter 14, more powerful than ever.
blocks.translation: 导数只有与第三部分的第二个主要概念——“积分”——结合起来，才能显示出全部威力。起初，这个话题似乎完全偏离了主线——本章中，导数连一次也没有出现！研究积分确实需要长时间的准备；但一旦完成这些前期工作，积分就会成为构造新函数的宝贵工具，而导数将在第 14 章重新登场，比以往任何时候都更有力量。

blocks.source: Although ultimately to be defined in a quite complicated way, the integral formalizes a simple, intuitive concept—that of area. By now it should come as no surprise to learn that the definition of an intuitive concept can present great difficulties—“area” is certainly no exception.
blocks.translation: 虽然积分最终要用一种相当复杂的方式来定义，它所精确表述的却是一个简单而直观的概念——面积。到现在，你应该已经不会惊讶于这样的事实：给直观概念下定义，可能会遇到巨大的困难——“面积”当然也不例外。

blocks.source: In elementary geometry, formulas are derived for the areas of many plane figures, but a little reflection shows that an acceptable definition of area is seldom given. The area of a region is sometimes defined as the number of squares, with sides of length $1$, which fit in the region. But this definition is hopelessly inadequate for any but the simplest regions. For example, a circle of radius $1$ supposedly has as area the irrational number $\pi$, but it is not at all clear what “$\pi$ squares” means. Even if we consider a circle of radius $1/\sqrt\pi$, which supposedly has area $1$, it is hard to say in what way a unit square fits in this circle, since it does not seem possible to divide the unit square into pieces which can be arranged to form a circle.
blocks.translation: 在初等几何中，我们推导了许多平面图形的面积公式，但稍加思考就会发现，那里很少给出令人满意的面积定义。有时，一个区域的面积被定义为能够放进该区域的边长为 $1$ 的正方形的个数。但除了最简单的区域，这个定义根本不够用。例如，半径为 $1$ 的圆，据说面积是无理数 $\pi$，可是“$\pi$ 个正方形”究竟意味着什么，完全说不清。即使考虑一个半径为 $1/\sqrt\pi$、据说面积为 $1$ 的圆，也很难说单位正方形怎样才能放进这个圆里，因为似乎无法把单位正方形分成一些碎片，再重新拼成一个圆。

blocks.source: In this chapter we will only try to define the area of some very special regions (Figure 1)—those which are bounded by the horizontal axis, the vertical lines through $(a,0)$ and $(b,0)$, and the graph of a function $f$ such that $f(x)\ge0$ for all $x$ in $[a,b]$. It is convenient to indicate this region by $R(f,a,b)$. Notice that these regions include rectangles and triangles, as well as many other important geometric figures.
blocks.translation: 本章只尝试为一些非常特殊的区域定义面积（图 1）——它们由水平轴、经过 $(a,0)$ 和 $(b,0)$ 的两条竖直直线，以及函数 $f$ 的图像围成，其中对 $[a,b]$ 中所有 $x$ 都有 $f(x)\ge0$。把这个区域记为 $R(f,a,b)$ 很方便。注意，这类区域包括矩形、三角形，以及许多其他重要的几何图形。

blocks.source: The number which we will eventually assign as the area of $R(f,a,b)$ will be called the *integral* of $f$ on $[a,b]$. blocks.translation: 我们最终赋予 $R(f,a,b)$ 作为面积的那个数，将称为 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上的*积分*。事实上，即使函数 $f$ 不满足对 $[a,b]$ 中所有 $x$ 都有 $f(x)\ge0$ 这一条件，积分也将得到定义。如果 $f$ 是图 2 中的函数，那么积分表示浅阴影区域的面积减去深阴影区域的面积（即 $R(f,a,b)$ 的“代数面积”）。

*The notation $\int_a^b f(x)dx$ is actually the older, and was for many years the only, symbol for the integral. Leibniz used this symbol because he considered the integral to be the sum (denoted by $\int$) of infinitely many rectangles with height $f(x)$ and “infinitely small” width $dx$. Later writers used $x_0,\ldots,x_n$ to denote the points of a partition, and abbreviated $x_i-x_{i-1}$ by $\Delta x_i$. The integral was defined as the limit as $\Delta x_i$ approaches $0$ of the sums $\sum_{i=1}^n f(x_i)\Delta x_i$ (analogous to lower and upper sums). The fact that the limit is obtained by changing $\sum$ to $\int$, $f(x_i)$ to $f(x)$, and $\Delta x_i$ to $dx$, delights many people.
blocks.translation: *记号 $\int_a^b f(x)dx$ 实际上更古老，而且多年间一直是积分的唯一记号。莱布尼茨采用这个符号，是因为他把积分看成无穷多个矩形的和（用 $\int$ 表示），每个矩形的高为 $f(x)$，宽为“无穷小”的 $dx$。后来的作者用 $x_0,\ldots,x_n$ 表示分割的点，并将 $x_i-x_{i-1}$ 简记为 $\Delta x_i$。积分被定义为当 $\Delta x_i$ 趋于 $0$ 时，和式 $\sum_{i=1}^n f(x_i)\Delta x_i$（类似于下和与上和）的极限。将 $\sum$ 改为 $\int$、将 $f(x_i)$ 改为 $f(x)$、将 $\Delta x_i$ 改为 $dx$，就得到了极限这一事实，令许多人十分欣喜。

**THEOREM 3** If $f$ is continuous on $[a,b]$, then $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$.
blocks.translation: **定理 3** 如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续，那么 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积。

blocks.source: **PROOF** Notice, first, that $f$ is bounded on $[a,b]$, because it is continuous on $[a,b]$. To prove that $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$, we want to use Theorem 2, and show that for every $\varepsilon>0$ there is a partition $P$ of $[a,b]$ such that
blocks.translation: **证明** 首先注意，由于 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续，因此它在 $[a,b]$ 上有界。为了证明 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，我们要使用定理 2，证明对于每个 $\varepsilon>0$，都存在 $[a,b]$ 的一个分割 $P$，使得

blocks.source: $$U(f,P)-L(f,P)<\varepsilon.$$
Now we know, by Theorem 1 of the Appendix to Chapter 8, that $f$ is uniformly continuous on $[a,b]$. So there is some $\delta>0$ such that for all $x$ and $y$ in $[a,b]$,
blocks.translation: 现在，由第 8 章附录的定理 1，我们知道 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上一致连续。因此存在某个 $\delta>0$，使得对 $[a,b]$ 中所有 $x$ 和 $y$，

blocks.source: $$\text{if }|x-y|<\delta,\text{ then }|f(x)-f(y)|<\frac{\varepsilon}{2(b-a)}.$$
The trick is simply to choose a partition $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ such that each $|t_i-t_{i-1}|<\delta$. Then for each $i$ we have
blocks.translation: 技巧只是选取一个分割 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$，使每个 $|t_i-t_{i-1}|<\delta$ 都成立。这样，对于每个 $i$，都有

blocks.source: $$|f(x)-f(y)|<\frac{\varepsilon}{2(b-a)}\quad\text{for all }x,y\text{ in }[t_{i-1},t_i],$$
and it follows easily that
blocks.translation: 由此容易得到

blocks.source: $$M_i-m_i\le\frac{\varepsilon}{2(b-a)}<\frac{\varepsilon}{b-a}.$$
Since this is true for all $i$, we then have
blocks.translation: 由于这对所有 $i$ 都成立，所以

blocks.source:
$$\begin{aligned}U(f,P)-L(f,P)&=\sum_{i=1}^n(M_i-m_i)(t_i-t_{i-1})\\
&<\frac{\varepsilon}{b-a}\sum_{i=1}^n t_i-t_{i-1}\\
&=\frac{\varepsilon}{b-a}\cdot b-a\\
&=\varepsilon,\end{aligned}$$
which is what we wanted. ▮
blocks.translation: 这正是我们要证明的。▮

blocks.source: Although this theorem will provide all the information necessary for the use of integrals in this book, it is more satisfying to have a somewhat larger supply of integrable functions. Several problems treat this question in detail. It will help to know the following three theorems, which show that $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$, if it is integrable on $[a,c]$ and $[c,b]$; that $f+g$ is integrable if $f$ and $g$ are; and that $c\cdot f$ is integrable if $f$ is integrable and $c$ is any number.
blocks.translation: 虽然这个定理已经提供了本书使用积分所需的全部信息，但若能掌握更大一类可积函数，总会更令人满意。若干习题将详细讨论这个问题。先知道下面三个定理会有帮助：它们分别说明，如果 $f$ 在 $[a,c]$ 和 $[c,b]$ 上可积，就在 $[a,b]$ 上可积；如果 $f$ 和 $g$ 可积，那么 $f+g$ 可积；如果 $f$ 可积且 $c$ 是任意数，那么 $c\cdot f$ 可积。

blocks.source: As a simple application of these theorems, recall that if $f$ is $0$ except at one point, where its value is $1$, then $f$ is integrable. Multiplying this function by $c$, it follows that the same is true if the value of $f$ at the exceptional point is $c$. Adding such a function to an integrable function, we see that the value of an integrable function may be changed arbitrarily at one point without destroying integrability. By breaking up the interval into many subintervals, we see that the value can be changed at finitely many points.
blocks.translation: 作为这些定理的一个简单应用，回想：如果 $f$ 除了一点取值为 $1$ 以外，处处为 $0$，那么 $f$ 可积。把这个函数乘以 $c$，就知道，即使 $f$ 在那个例外点的值为 $c$，结论仍然成立。将这样的函数加到一个可积函数上，便看出：可以任意改变可积函数在一个点的值，而不破坏可积性。把区间分成许多子区间，又可以看出，有限多个点的值都可以改变。

blocks.translation: 这些定理的证明，通常使用定理 2 中的另一种可积性判别条件；正如前面某些论证所显示的那样，证明中的

blocks.source: argument often conspire to obscure the point of the proof. It is a good idea to attempt proofs of your own, consulting those given here as a last resort, or as a check. This will probably clarify the proofs, and will certainly give good practice in the techniques used in some of the problems.
blocks.translation: 细节往往会合在一起，掩盖证明的要点。不妨先试着自己证明，万不得已时才参考这里给出的证明，或者用它来核对。这样做很可能让证明变得更清楚，也一定能很好地练习某些习题中用到的技巧。

blocks.source: **THEOREM 4** Let $a<c<b$. If $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$, then $f$ is integrable on $[a,c]$ and on $[c,b]$. Conversely, if $f$ is integrable on $[a,c]$ and on $[c,b]$, then $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$. Finally, if $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$, then
blocks.translation: **定理 4** 设 $a<c<b$。如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，那么 $f$ 在 $[a,c]$ 和 $[c,b]$ 上都可积。反过来，如果 $f$ 在 $[a,c]$ 和 $[c,b]$ 上都可积，那么 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积。最后，如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，那么

blocks.source: $$\int_a^b f=\int_a^c f+\int_c^b f.$$
**PROOF** Suppose $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$. If $\varepsilon>0$, there is a partition $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ of $[a,b]$ such that
blocks.translation: **证明** 假设 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积。如果 $\varepsilon>0$，则存在 $[a,b]$ 的一个分割 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$，使得

blocks.source: $$U(f,P)-L(f,P)<\varepsilon.$$

We might as well assume that $c=t_j$ for some $j$. (Otherwise, let $Q$ be the partition which contains $t_0,\ldots,t_n$ and $c$; then $Q$ contains $P$, so $U(f,Q)-L(f,Q)\le U(f,P)-L(f,P)<\varepsilon$.)
blocks.translation: 不妨假设对某个 $j$ 有 $c=t_j$。（否则，令 $Q$ 为包含 $t_0,\ldots,t_n$ 和 $c$ 的分割；那么 $Q$ 包含 $P$，所以 $U(f,Q)-L(f,Q)\le U(f,P)-L(f,P)<\varepsilon$。）

blocks.source: Now $P'=\{t_0,\ldots,t_j\}$ is a partition of $[a,c]$ and $P''=\{t_j,\ldots,t_n\}$ is a partition of $[c,b]$ (Figure 12). Since
blocks.translation: 现在，$P'=\{t_0,\ldots,t_j\}$ 是 $[a,c]$ 的一个分割，而 $P''=\{t_j,\ldots,t_n\}$ 是 $[c,b]$ 的一个分割（图 12）。由于

blocks.source: $$\begin{aligned}L(f,P)&=L(f,P')+L(f,P''),\\U(f,P)&=U(f,P')+U(f,P''),\end{aligned}$$
we have
blocks.translation: 所以

blocks.source: $$[U(f,P')-L(f,P')]+[U(f,P'')-L(f,P'')]=U(f,P)-L(f,P)<\varepsilon.$$
Since each of the terms in brackets is nonnegative, each is less than $\varepsilon$. This shows that $f$ is integrable on $[a,c]$ and $[c,b]$. Note also that
blocks.translation: 由于方括号中的每一项都非负，因此每一项都小于 $\varepsilon$。这就表明，$f$ 在 $[a,c]$ 和 $[c,b]$ 上可积。还要注意，

blocks.source: $$L(f,P')\le\int_a^c f\le U(f,P'),$$
$$L(f,P'')\le\int_c^b f\le U(f,P''),$$
so that
blocks.translation: 所以

blocks.source: $$L(f,P)\le\int_a^c f+\int_c^b f\le U(f,P).$$
Since this is true for any $P$, this proves that
blocks.translation: 由于这对任意 $P$ 都成立，因此证明了

blocks.source: $$\int_a^c f+\int_c^b f=\int_a^b f.$$
Now suppose that $f$ is integrable on $[a,c]$ and on $[c,b]$. If $\varepsilon>0$, there is a partition $P'$ of $[a,c]$ and a partition $P''$ of $[c,b]$ such that
blocks.translation: 现在假设 $f$ 在 $[a,c]$ 和 $[c,b]$ 上都可积。如果 $\varepsilon>0$，则存在 $[a,c]$ 的一个分割 $P'$，以及 $[c,b]$ 的一个分割 $P''$，使得

blocks.source: $$U(f,P')-L(f,P')<\varepsilon/2,$$
$$U(f,P'')-L(f,P'')<\varepsilon/2.$$
If $P$ is the partition of $[a,b]$ containing all the points of $P'$ and $P''$, then
blocks.translation: 如果 $P$ 是由 $P'$ 和 $P''$ 中所有点组成的 $[a,b]$ 的分割，那么

blocks.source: $$\begin{aligned}L(f,P)&=L(f,P')+L(f,P''),\\U(f,P)&=U(f,P')+U(f,P'');\end{aligned}$$
consequently,
blocks.translation: 因此，

blocks.source: $$U(f,P)-L(f,P)=[U(f,P')-L(f,P')]+[U(f,P'')-L(f,P'')]<\varepsilon.\quad\text{▮}$$
Theorem 4 is the basis for some minor notational conventions. The integral $\int_a^b f$ was defined only for $a<b$. We now add the definitions
blocks.translation: 定理 4 是一些小的记号约定的依据。积分 $\int_a^b f$ 原来只在 $a<b$ 时有定义。现在补充以下定义：

blocks.source: $$\int_a^a f=0\quad\text{and}\quad\int_a^b f=-\int_b^a f\quad\text{if }a>b.$$
With these definitions, the equation $\int_a^c f+\int_c^b f=\int_a^b f$ holds for all $a,c,b$ even if $a<c<b$ is not true (the proof of this assertion is a rather tedious case-by-case check).
blocks.translation: 有了这些定义，等式 $\int_a^c f+\int_c^b f=\int_a^b f$ 对所有 $a,c,b$ 都成立，即使 $a<c<b$ 不成立也如此（这个断言的证明，是一番相当乏味的逐一分类检验）。

blocks.source: **THEOREM 5** If $f$ and $g$ are integrable on $[a,b]$, then $f+g$ is integrable on $[a,b]$ and
blocks.translation: **定理 5** 如果 $f$ 和 $g$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，那么 $f+g$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，并且

blocks.source: $$\int_a^b(f+g)=\int_a^b f+\int_a^b g.$$
**PROOF** Let $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ be any partition of $[a,b]$. Let
blocks.translation: **证明** 设 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ 是 $[a,b]$ 的任意分割。令

blocks.source:
$$\begin{aligned}m_i&=\inf\{(f+g)(x):t_{i-1}\le x\le t_i\},\\
m_i'&=\inf\{f(x):t_{i-1}\le x\le t_i\},\\
m_i''&=\inf\{g(x):t_{i-1}\le x\le t_i\},\end{aligned}$$
and define $M_i,M_i',M_i''$ similarly. It is not necessarily true that
blocks.translation: 并类似地定义 $M_i,M_i',M_i''$。下式不一定成立：

blocks.source: but it is true (Problem 10) that
blocks.translation: 但确实有（习题 10）

blocks.source: Similarly,
blocks.translation: 类似地，

blocks.source: Therefore,
blocks.translation: 因此，

blocks.source: $$L(f,P)+L(g,P)\le L(f+g,P)$$
and
blocks.translation: 并且

blocks.source: $$U(f+g,P)\le U(f,P)+U(g,P).$$
Thus,
blocks.translation: 所以，

blocks.source: $$L(f,P)+L(g,P)\le L(f+g,P)\le U(f+g,P)\le U(f,P)+U(g,P).$$
Since $f$ and $g$ are integrable, there are partitions $P',P''$ with
blocks.translation: 由于 $f$ 和 $g$ 可积，存在分割 $P',P''$，使得

blocks.source: $$U(f,P')-L(f,P')<\varepsilon/2,$$
$$U(g,P'')-L(g,P'')<\varepsilon/2.$$
If $P$ contains both $P'$ and $P''$, then
blocks.translation: 如果 $P$ 同时包含 $P'$ 和 $P''$，那么

blocks.source: $$U(f,P)+U(g,P)-[L(f,P)+L(g,P)]<\varepsilon,$$
and consequently
blocks.translation: 因此

blocks.source: $$U(f+g,P)-L(f+g,P)<\varepsilon.$$
This proves that $f+g$ is integrable on $[a,b]$. Moreover,
blocks.translation: 这就证明了 $f+g$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积。此外，

blocks.source: $$\begin{aligned}(1)\qquad L(f,P)+L(g,P)&\le L(f+g,P)\\&\le\int_a^b(f+g)\\&\le U(f+g,P)\le U(f,P)+U(g,P);\end{aligned}$$
and also
blocks.translation: 并且还有

blocks.source: $$(2)\qquad L(f,P)+L(g,P)\le\int_a^b f+\int_a^b g\le U(f,P)+U(g,P).$$
Since $U(f,P)-L(f,P)$ and $U(g,P)-L(g,P)$ can both be made as small as desired, it follows that
blocks.translation: 由于 $U(f,P)-L(f,P)$ 和 $U(g,P)-L(g,P)$ 都可以任意小，因此

blocks.source: can also be made as small as desired; it therefore follows from (1) and (2) that
blocks.translation: 也可以任意小；所以由 (1) 和 (2) 得到

blocks.source: $$\int_a^b(f+g)=\int_a^b f+\int_a^b g.\quad\text{▮}$$
**THEOREM 6** If $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$, then for any number $c$, the function $cf$ is integrable on $[a,b]$ and
blocks.translation: **定理 6** 如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，那么对于任意数 $c$，函数 $cf$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，并且

blocks.source: $$\int_a^b cf=c\cdot\int_a^b f.$$
**PROOF** The proof (which is much easier than that of Theorem 5) is left to you. It is a good idea to treat separately the cases $c\ge0$ and $c\le0$. Why? ▮
blocks.translation: **证明** 证明（比定理 5 的证明容易得多）留给你。最好分别处理 $c\ge0$ 和 $c\le0$ 两种情形。为什么？▮

blocks.source: (Theorem 6 is just a special case of the more general theorem that $f\cdot g$ is integrable on $[a,b]$, if $f$ and $g$ are, but this result is quite hard to prove (see Problem 38).)
blocks.translation: （定理 6 只是一个更一般的定理的特例：如果 $f$ 和 $g$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，那么 $f\cdot g$ 也可积。但这个结果相当难证明，见习题 38。）

blocks.source: In this chapter we have acquired only one complicated definition, a few simple theorems with intricate proofs, and one theorem which required material from the Appendix to Chapter 8. This is not because integrals constitute a more difficult topic than derivatives, but because powerful tools developed in previous chapters have been allowed to remain dormant. The most significant discovery of calculus is the fact that the integral and the derivative are intimately related—once we learn the connection, the integral will become as useful as the derivative, and as easy to use. The connection between derivatives and integrals deserves a separate chapter, but the preparations which we will make in this chapter may serve as a hint. We first state a simple inequality concerning integrals, which plays a role in many important theorems.
blocks.translation: 本章到目前为止，我们只得到了一个复杂的定义、几个证明繁复的简单定理，以及一个需要借助第 8 章附录内容的定理。这并非因为积分比导数更难，而是因为前几章发展出来的有力工具一直被搁置着。微积分最重要的发现，是积分与导数之间有着密切的联系——一旦掌握这种联系，积分就会变得与导数同样有用，也同样容易使用。导数与积分之间的联系值得单独用一章来讨论，不过，本章中将做的一些准备，也许可以给出一点暗示。我们先陈述一个简单的积分不等式，它在许多重要定理中都起着作用。

blocks.source: **THEOREM 7** Suppose $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$ and that
blocks.translation: **定理 7** 设 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，并且

blocks.source: $$m\le f(x)\le M\quad\text{for all }x\text{ in }[a,b].$$
Then
blocks.translation: 那么

blocks.source: $$m(b-a)\le\int_a^b f\le M(b-a).$$
**PROOF** It is clear that
blocks.translation: **证明** 显然有

blocks.source: $$m(b-a)\le L(f,P)\quad\text{and}\quad U(f,P)\le M(b-a)$$
for every partition $P$. Since $\int_a^b f=\sup\{L(f,P)\}=\inf\{U(f,P)\}$, the desired inequality follows immediately. ▮
blocks.translation: 这对每个分割 $P$ 都成立。由于 $\int_a^b f=\sup\{L(f,P)\}=\inf\{U(f,P)\}$，所需的不等式立即成立。▮

blocks.source: Suppose now that $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$. We can define a new function $f$ on $[a,b]$ by
blocks.translation: 现在假设 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积。我们可以在 $[a,b]$ 上定义一个新函数 $f$：

blocks.source: $$F(x)=\int_a^x f=\int_a^x f(t)dt.$$

(This depends on Theorem 4.) We have seen that $f$ may be integrable even if it is not continuous, and the Problems give examples of integrable functions which are quite pathological. The behavior of $F$ is therefore a very pleasant surprise.
blocks.translation: （这依赖于定理 4。）我们已经看到，$f$ 即使不连续，也可能可积；习题还给出了一些颇为病态的可积函数的例子。因此，$F$ 的表现带来了一个非常令人愉快的惊喜。

blocks.source: **THEOREM 8** If $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$ and $F$ is defined on $[a,b]$ by
blocks.translation: **定理 8** 如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，且在 $[a,b]$ 上定义 $F$ 为

blocks.source: $$F(x)=\int_a^x f,$$
then $F$ is continuous on $[a,b]$.
blocks.translation: 那么 $F$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续。

blocks.source: **PROOF** Suppose $c$ is in $[a,b]$. Since $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$ it is, by definition, bounded on $[a,b]$; let $M$ be a number such that
blocks.translation: **证明** 设 $c$ 属于 $[a,b]$。由于 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，按照定义，它在 $[a,b]$ 上有界；取一个数 $M$，使得

blocks.source: $$|f(x)|\le M\quad\text{for all }x\text{ in }[a,b].$$
If $h>0$, then (Figure 13)
blocks.translation: 如果 $h>0$，那么（图 13）

blocks.source: $$F(c+h)-F(c)=\int_a^{c+h}f-\int_a^c f=\int_c^{c+h}f.$$
Since
blocks.translation: 由于

blocks.source: $$-M\le f(x)\le M\quad\text{for all }x,$$
it follows from Theorem 7 that
blocks.translation: 由定理 7 得到

blocks.source: $$-M\cdot h\le\int_c^{c+h}f\le Mh;$$
in other words,
blocks.translation: 换句话说，

blocks.source: $$(1)\qquad -M\cdot h\le F(c+h)-F(c)\le M\cdot h.$$
If $h<0$, a similar inequality can be derived: Note that
blocks.translation: 如果 $h<0$，可以得到类似的不等式：注意

blocks.source: $$F(c+h)-F(c)=\int_c^{c+h}f=-\int_{c+h}^c f.$$
Applying Theorem 7 to the interval $[c+h,c]$, of length $-h$, we obtain
blocks.translation: 对长度为 $-h$ 的区间 $[c+h,c]$ 应用定理 7，得到

blocks.source: $$Mh\le\int_{c+h}^c f\le-Mh;$$
multiplying by $-1$, which reverses all the inequalities, we have
blocks.translation: 乘以 $-1$，所有不等号的方向都反转，得到

blocks.source: $$(2)\qquad Mh\le F(c+h)-F(c)\le-Mh.$$
Inequalities (1) and (2) can be combined:
blocks.translation: 不等式 (1) 和 (2) 可以合并为

blocks.source: $$|F(c+h)-F(c)|\le M\cdot|h|.$$
Therefore, if $\varepsilon>0$, we have
blocks.translation: 因此，如果 $\varepsilon>0$，就有

blocks.source: $$|F(c+h)-F(c)|<\varepsilon,$$
provided that $|h|<\varepsilon/M$. This proves that
blocks.translation: 只要 $|h|<\varepsilon/M$。这就证明了

blocks.source: in other words $F$ is continuous at $c$. ▮
blocks.translation: 换句话说，$F$ 在 $c$ 处连续。▮

blocks.source: Figure 14 compares $f$ and $F(x)=\int_a^x f$ for various functions $f$; it appears that $F$ is always better behaved than $f$. In the next chapter we will see how true this is.
blocks.translation: 图 14 对不同的函数 $f$，比较了 $f$ 与 $F(x)=\int_a^x f$；看来 $F$ 的表现总是比 $f$ 更好。下一章将看到，这一点究竟有多么确切。

blocks.source: ## PROBLEMS
blocks.translation: ## 习题

blocks.source: Prove that $\int_0^b x^3dx=b^4/4$, by considering partitions into $n$ equal subintervals, using the formula for $\sum_{i=1}^n i^3$ which was found in Problem 2-6. This problem requires only a straightforward imitation of calculations in the text, but you should write it up as a formal proof to make certain that all the fine points of the argument are clear.
blocks.translation: 考虑把区间分成 $n$ 个相等子区间的分割，并利用习题 2-6 中得到的 $\sum_{i=1}^n i^3$ 公式，证明 $\int_0^b x^3dx=b^4/4$。这道题只需直接模仿正文中的计算，但你应将其写成正式证明，以确保论证中的所有细节都已弄清。

blocks.source: Prove, similarly, that $\int_0^b x^4dx=b^5/5$.
blocks.translation: 类似地，证明 $\int_0^b x^4dx=b^5/5$。

blocks.source: (a) Using Problem 2-7, show that the sum $\sum_{k=1}^n k^p/n^{p+1}$ can be made as close to $1/(p+1)$ as desired, by choosing $n$ large enough.
blocks.translation: (a) 利用习题 2-7，证明：只要把 $n$ 取得足够大，就能使和式 $\sum_{k=1}^n k^p/n^{p+1}$ 任意接近 $1/(p+1)$。

blocks.source: (b) Prove that $\int_0^b x^pdx=b^{p+1}/(p+1)$.
blocks.translation: (b) 证明 $\int_0^b x^pdx=b^{p+1}/(p+1)$。

blocks.source: This problem outlines a clever way to find $\int_a^b x^pdx$ for $0<a<b$. (The result for $a=0$ will then follow by continuity.) The trick is to use partitions $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ for which all *ratios* $r=t_i/t_{i-1}$ are equal, instead of using partitions for which all differences $t_i-t_{i-1}$ are equal.
blocks.translation: 本题概述一种在 $0<a<b$ 时求 $\int_a^b x^pdx$ 的巧妙方法。（$a=0$ 时的结果随后可由连续性得到。）技巧是使用使所有*比值* $r=t_i/t_{i-1}$ 都相等的分割 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$，而不是使用使所有差 $t_i-t_{i-1}$ 都相等的分割。

blocks.source: (a) Show that for such a partition $P$ we have
blocks.translation: (a) 证明：对于这样的分割 $P$，有

blocks.source: $$t_i=a\cdot c^{i/n}\quad\text{for }c=\frac ba.$$
(b) If $f(x)=x^p$, show, using the formula in Problem 2-5, that
blocks.translation: (b) 若 $f(x)=x^p$，利用习题 2-5 中的公式，证明

blocks.source: Evaluate without doing any computations:

blocks.source: (i) $\displaystyle\int_{-1}^1 x^3\sqrt{1-x^2}dx.$
(ii) $\displaystyle\int_{-1}^1(x^5+3)\sqrt{1-x^2}dx.$
Prove that
blocks.translation: 证明

blocks.source: $$\int_0^x\frac{\sin t}{t+1}dt>0$$

blocks.source: Decide which of the following functions are integrable on $[0,2]$, and calculate the integral when you can.
blocks.translation: 判断下面哪些函数在 $[0,2]$ 上可积，并在能计算时求出积分。

blocks.source: (i) $\displaystyle f(x)=\begin{cases}x,&0\le x<1\\x-2,&1\le x\le2.\end{cases}$
(ii) $\displaystyle f(x)=\begin{cases}x,&0\le x\le1\\x-2,&1<x\le2.\end{cases}$
(iv) $\displaystyle f(x)=\begin{cases}x+[x],&x\text{ rational}\\0,&x\text{ irrational}.\end{cases}$
(v) $\displaystyle f(x)=\begin{cases}1,&x\text{ of the form }a+b\sqrt2\text{ for rational }a\text{ and }b\\0,&x\text{ not of this form}.\end{cases}$
(vi) $\displaystyle f(x)=\begin{cases}\dfrac1{\left[\dfrac1x\right]},&0<x\le1\\0,&x=0\text{ or }x>1.\end{cases}$
(vii) $f$ is the function shown in Figure 15.
blocks.translation: (vii) $f$ 是图 15 所示的函数。

blocks.source: Find the areas of the regions bounded by

blocks.source: (i) the graphs of $f(x)=x^2$ and $g(x)=\dfrac{x^2}2+2$.
blocks.translation: (i) $f(x)=x^2$ 和 $g(x)=\dfrac{x^2}2+2$ 的图像。

blocks.source: (vi) the graph of $f(x)=\sqrt x$, the horizontal axis, and the vertical line through $(2,0)$. blocks.translation: (vi) $f(x)=\sqrt x$ 的图像、水平轴，以及经过 $(2,0)$ 的竖直直线。（不要尝试求 $\int_0^2\sqrt x\,dx$；你应当能看出一种仅利用已经会计算的积分来猜出答案的方法。这个例子应当引发的问题，将在习题 21 中讨论。）

blocks.source: Find
blocks.translation: 求

blocks.source: Prove, using the notation of Theorem 5, that

blocks.source: (a) Which functions have the property that every lower sum equals every upper sum?
blocks.translation: (a) 哪些函数具有每个下和都等于每个上和的性质？

blocks.source: (b) Which functions have the property that some upper sum equals some (other) lower sum?
blocks.translation: (b) 哪些函数具有某个上和等于某个（另外的）下和的性质？

blocks.source: (c) Which continuous functions have the property that all lower sums are equal?
blocks.translation: (c) 哪些连续函数具有所有下和都相等的性质？

blocks.source: \*(d) Which integrable functions have the property that all lower sums are equal? (Bear in mind that one such function is $f(x)=0$ for $x$ irrational, $f(x)=1/q$ for $x=p/q$ in lowest terms.) Hint: You will need the notion of a dense set, introduced in Problem 8-6, as well as the results of Problem 30.
blocks.translation: \*(d) 哪些可积函数具有所有下和都相等的性质？（记住，一个这样的函数是：当 $x$ 为无理数时，$f(x)=0$；当 $x=p/q$ 为最简分数时，$f(x)=1/q$。）提示：你需要用到习题 8-6 中引入的稠密集概念，以及习题 30 的结果。

blocks.source: If $a<b<c<d$ and $f$ is integrable on $[a,d]$, prove that $f$ is integrable on $[b,c]$. (Don’t work hard.)
blocks.translation: 若 $a<b<c<d$，且 $f$ 在 $[a,d]$ 上可积，证明 $f$ 在 $[b,c]$ 上可积。（别费太多劲。）

blocks.source: (a) Prove that if $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$ and $f(x)\ge0$ for all $x$ in $[a,b]$, then $\int_a^b f\ge0$.
blocks.translation: (a) 证明：如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，而且对 $[a,b]$ 中所有 $x$ 都有 $f(x)\ge0$，那么 $\int_a^b f\ge0$。

blocks.source: (b) Prove that if $f$ and $g$ are integrable on $[a,b]$ and $f(x)\ge g(x)$ for all $x$ in $[a,b]$, then $\int_a^b f\ge\int_a^b g$. (By now it should be unnecessary to warn that if you work hard on part (b) you are wasting time.)
blocks.translation: (b) 证明：如果 $f$ 和 $g$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，而且对 $[a,b]$ 中所有 $x$ 都有 $f(x)\ge g(x)$，那么 $\int_a^b f\ge\int_a^b g$。（到现在，应该无需再提醒：如果你在 (b) 上费了很大力气，那就是在浪费时间。）

blocks.source: Prove that
blocks.translation: 证明

blocks.source: $$\int_a^b f(x)dx=\int_{a+c}^{b+c}f(x-c)dx.$$

(The geometric interpretation should make this very plausible.) Hint: Every partition $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ of $[a,b]$ gives rise to a partition $P'=\{t_0+c,\ldots,t_n+c\}$ of $[a+c,b+c]$, and conversely.
blocks.translation: （从几何解释来看，这应当很可信。）提示：$[a,b]$ 的每个分割 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$，都给出 $[a+c,b+c]$ 的一个分割 $P'=\{t_0+c,\ldots,t_n+c\}$，反过来也一样。

blocks.source: For $a,b>1$ prove that
blocks.translation: 对于 $a,b>1$，证明

blocks.source: $$\int_1^a\frac1t\,dt+\int_1^b\frac1t\,dt=\int_1^{ab}\frac1t\,dt.$$
Hint: This can be written $\int_1^a1/t\,dt=\int_b^{ab}1/t\,dt$. Every partition $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ of $[1,a]$ gives rise to a partition $P'=\{bt_0,\ldots,bt_n\}$ of $[b,ab]$, and conversely.
blocks.translation: 提示：可以将其写成 $\int_1^a1/t\,dt=\int_b^{ab}1/t\,dt$。$[1,a]$ 的每个分割 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$，都给出 $[b,ab]$ 的一个分割 $P'=\{bt_0,\ldots,bt_n\}$，反过来也一样。

blocks.source: Given that the area enclosed by the unit circle, described by the equation $x^2+y^2=1$, is $\pi$, use Problem 16 to show that the area enclosed by the ellipse described by the equation $x^2/a^2+y^2/b^2=1$ is $\pi ab$.
blocks.translation: 已知方程 $x^2+y^2=1$ 所描述的单位圆围成的面积为 $\pi$，利用习题 16，证明方程 $x^2/a^2+y^2/b^2=1$ 所描述的椭圆围成的面积为 $\pi ab$。

blocks.source: This problem outlines yet another way to compute $\int_a^b x^n dx$; it was used by Cavalieri, one of the mathematicians working just before the invention of calculus.
blocks.translation: 本题概述计算 $\int_a^b x^n dx$ 的又一种方法；卡瓦列里曾使用过这个方法，他是在微积分发明前夕从事研究的一位数学家。

blocks.source: (a) Let $c_n=\int_0^1 x^n dx$. Use Problem 16 to show that $\int_0^a x^n dx=c_n a^{n+1}$.
blocks.translation: (a) 设 $c_n=\int_0^1 x^n dx$。利用习题 16 证明 $\int_0^a x^n dx=c_n a^{n+1}$。

blocks.source: (b) Problem 14 shows that
blocks.translation: (b) 习题 14 表明

blocks.source: $$\int_0^{2a}x^n dx=\int_{-a}^a(x+a)^n dx.$$
Use this formula to prove that
blocks.translation: 利用这个公式证明

blocks.source: $$2^{n+1}c_n a^{n+1}=2a^{n+1}\sum_{k\text{ even}}\binom nk c_k.$$
(c) Now use Problem 2-3 to prove that $c_n=1/(n+1)$.
blocks.translation: (c) 现在利用习题 2-3 证明 $c_n=1/(n+1)$。

blocks.source: Suppose that $f$ is bounded on $[a,b]$ and that $f$ is continuous at each point in $[a,b]$ with the exception of $x_0$ in $(a,b)$. Prove that $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$. Hint: Imitate one of the examples in the text.
blocks.translation: 设 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上有界，而且 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 中除 $(a,b)$ 内的点 $x_0$ 以外的每一点都连续。证明 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积。提示：模仿正文中的一个例子。

blocks.source: Suppose that $f$ is nondecreasing on $[a,b]$. Notice that $f$ is automatically bounded on $[a,b]$, because $f(a)\le f(x)\le f(b)$ for $x$ in $[a,b]$.
blocks.translation: 设 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上非递减。注意，$f$ 自动在 $[a,b]$ 上有界，因为对 $[a,b]$ 中的 $x$，有 $f(a)\le f(x)\le f(b)$。

blocks.source: (a) If $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ is a partition of $[a,b]$, what is $L(f,P)$ and $U(f,P)$?
blocks.translation: (a) 如果 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ 是 $[a,b]$ 的一个分割，$L(f,P)$ 和 $U(f,P)$ 分别是什么？

blocks.source: (b) Suppose that $t_i-t_{i-1}=\delta$ for each $i$. Prove that $U(f,P)-L(f,P)=\delta[f(b)-f(a)]$.
blocks.translation: (b) 假设对每个 $i$ 都有 $t_i-t_{i-1}=\delta$。证明 $U(f,P)-L(f,P)=\delta[f(b)-f(a)]$。

blocks.source: (c) Prove that $f$ is integrable.
blocks.translation: (c) 证明 $f$ 可积。

blocks.source: (d) Give an example of a nondecreasing function on $[0,1]$ which is discontinuous at infinitely many points.
blocks.translation: (d) 举出一个在 $[0,1]$ 上非递减、却在无穷多个点不连续的函数。

blocks.source: It might be of interest to compare this problem with the following extract from Newton’s *Principia*.*
blocks.translation: 把这道题与下面摘自牛顿《原理》的文字作一比较，也许会很有意思。*

blocks.source: LEMMA II
blocks.translation: 引理 II

blocks.source: *If in any figure* AacE, *terminated by the right lines* Aa, AE, *and the curve* acE, *there be inscribed any number of parallelograms* Ab, Bc, Cd, &c., *comprehended under equal bases* AB, BC, CD, &c., *and the sides,* Bb, Cc, Dd, &c., *parallel to one side* Aa *of the figure; and the parallelograms* aKbl, bLcm, cMdn, &c., *are completed: then if the breadth of those parallelograms be supposed to be diminished, and their number to be augmented* in infinitum, *I say, that the ultimate ratios which the inscribed figure* AKbLcMdD, *the circumscribed figure* AalbmcndoE, *and curvilinear figure* AabcdE, *will have to one another, are ratios of equality.*
blocks.translation: *若任一图形* AacE *由直线* Aa、AE *及曲线* acE *围成，在其中内接任意多个平行四边形* Ab、Bc、Cd *等，它们的底* AB、BC、CD *等彼此相等，各边* Bb、Cc、Dd *等平行于图形的一边* Aa；*再补成平行四边形* aKbl、bLcm、cMdn *等：那么，假定这些平行四边形的宽度不断减小，而个数无限增加，我断言，内接图形* AKbLcMdD、*外切图形* AalbmcndoE *与曲边图形* AabcdE *彼此之间的最终比，都是相等之比。*

blocks.source: For the difference of the inscribed and circumscribed figures is the sum of the parallelograms Kl, Lm, Mn, Do, that is (from the equality of all their bases), the rectangle under one of their bases Kb and the sum of their altitudes Aa, that is, the rectangle ABla. But this rectangle, because its breadth AB is supposed diminished *in infinitum*, becomes less than any given space. And therefore (by Lem. 1) the figures inscribed and circumscribed become ultimately equal one to the other; and much more will the intermediate curvilinear figure be ultimately equal to either. Q.E.D.
blocks.translation: 因为内接图形与外切图形之差，是平行四边形 Kl、Lm、Mn、Do 的总和；也就是说（由于它们的底全部相等），它等于以其中一个底 Kb 为底、以各高之和 Aa 为高的矩形，也就是矩形 ABla。但这个矩形的宽 AB 被假定为*无限*减小，因此它会小于任何给定的面积。所以（由引理 1），内接图形与外切图形最终彼此相等；夹在它们之间的曲边图形，就更会最终与二者中的任何一个相等。证毕。

blocks.translation: 设 $f$ 递增。图 16 提示

blocks.translation: (a) 若 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ 是 $[a,b]$ 的一个分割，令 $P'=\{f^{-1}(t_0),\ldots,f^{-1}(t_n)\}$。证明，如图 17 所提示的，

blocks.source: (b) Now prove the formula stated above.
blocks.translation: (b) 现在证明上面陈述的公式。

blocks.source: (c) Find $\int_a^b\sqrt[n]x\,dx$ for $0\le a<b$.
blocks.translation: (c) 对于 $0\le a<b$，求 $\int_a^b\sqrt[n]x\,dx$。

blocks.source: Suppose that $f$ is a continuous increasing function with $f(0)=0$. Prove that for $a,b>0$ we have *Young’s inequality*,
blocks.translation: 设 $f$ 是满足 $f(0)=0$ 的连续递增函数。证明，对于 $a,b>0$，成立*杨氏不等式*：

blocks.source: $$ab\le\int_0^a f(x)dx+\int_0^b f^{-1}(x)dx,$$
and that equality holds if and only if $b=f(a)$. Hint: Draw a picture like Figure 16!
blocks.translation: 并且等号成立当且仅当 $b=f(a)$。提示：画一幅像图 16 那样的图！

(a) Prove that if $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$ and $m\le f(x)\le M$ for all $x$ in $[a,b]$, then
blocks.translation: (a) 证明：如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，且对 $[a,b]$ 中所有 $x$ 都有 $m\le f(x)\le M$，那么

blocks.source: $$\int_a^b f(x)dx=(b-a)\mu$$
for some number $\mu$ with $m\le\mu\le M$.
blocks.translation: 其中 $\mu$ 是满足 $m\le\mu\le M$ 的某个数。

blocks.source: (b) Prove that if $f$ is continuous on $[a,b]$, then
blocks.translation: (b) 证明：如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续，那么

blocks.source: $$\int_a^b f(x)dx=(b-a)f(\xi)$$
for some $\xi$ in $[a,b]$.
blocks.translation: 其中 $\xi$ 是 $[a,b]$ 中某个数。

blocks.source: (c) Show by an example that continuity is essential.
blocks.translation: (c) 举例说明，连续性条件不可缺少。

blocks.source: (d) More generally, suppose that $f$ is continuous on $[a,b]$ and that $g$ is integrable and nonnegative on $[a,b]$. Prove that
blocks.translation: (d) 更一般地，设 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续，而 $g$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积且非负。证明

blocks.source: $$\int_a^b f(x)g(x)dx=f(\xi)\int_a^b g(x)dx$$
for some $\xi$ in $[a,b]$. This result is called the Mean Value Theorem for Integrals.
blocks.translation: 其中 $\xi$ 是 $[a,b]$ 中某个数。这个结果称为积分中值定理。

blocks.source: (e) Deduce the same result if $g$ is integrable and nonpositive on $[a,b]$.
blocks.translation: (e) 如果 $g$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积且非正，推导同样的结果。

blocks.source: (f) Show that one of these two hypotheses for $g$ is essential.
blocks.translation: (f) 证明，关于 $g$ 的这两个假设中，必须有一个成立。

blocks.source: In this problem we consider the graph of a function in polar coordinates (Chapter 4, Appendix 3). Figure 18 shows a sector of a circle, with central angle $\theta$. When $\theta$ is measured in radians, the area of this sector is $r^2\cdot\dfrac\theta2$. Now consider the region $A$ shown in Figure 19, where the curve is the graph in polar coordinates of the continuous function $f$. Show that
blocks.translation: 本题考虑函数在极坐标下的图像（第 4 章附录 3）。图 18 画出了一个圆心角为 $\theta$ 的扇形。当 $\theta$ 用弧度度量时，这个扇形的面积为 $r^2\cdot\dfrac\theta2$。现在考虑图 19 中的区域 $A$，其中曲线是连续函数 $f$ 在极坐标下的图像。证明

blocks.source: $$\text{area }A=\frac12\int_{\theta_0}^{\theta_1}f(\theta)^2d\theta.$$
Let $f$ be a continuous function on $[a,b]$. If $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ is a partition of $[a,b]$, define
blocks.translation: 设 $f$ 是 $[a,b]$ 上的连续函数。如果 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ 是 $[a,b]$ 的一个分割，定义

blocks.source: The number $\ell(f,P)$ represents the length of a polygonal curve inscribed in the graph of $f$ (see Figure 20). We define the **length** of $f$ on $[a,b]$ to be the least upper bound of all $\ell(f,P)$ for all partitions $P$ (provided that the set of all such $\ell(f,P)$ is bounded above).
blocks.translation: 数 $\ell(f,P)$ 表示内接于 $f$ 图像的一条折线的长度（见图 20）。我们把 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上的**长度**定义为：遍历所有分割 $P$ 时，所有 $\ell(f,P)$ 的最小上界（前提是所有这些 $\ell(f,P)$ 组成的集合有上界）。

blocks.source: (a) If $f$ is a linear function on $[a,b]$, prove that the length of $f$ is the distance from $(a,f(a))$ to $(b,f(b))$.
blocks.translation: (a) 如果 $f$ 是 $[a,b]$ 上的线性函数，证明 $f$ 的长度就是 $(a,f(a))$ 到 $(b,f(b))$ 的距离。

blocks.source: (b) If $f$ is not linear, prove that there is a partition $P=\{a,t,b\}$ of $[a,b]$ such that $\ell(f,P)$ is greater than the distance from $(a,f(a))$ to $(b,f(b))$. (You will need Problem 4-9.)
blocks.translation: (b) 如果 $f$ 不是线性的，证明存在 $[a,b]$ 的一个分割 $P=\{a,t,b\}$，使得 $\ell(f,P)$ 大于 $(a,f(a))$ 到 $(b,f(b))$ 的距离。（需要用到习题 4-9。）

blocks.source: (c) Conclude that of all functions $f$ on $[a,b]$ with $f(a)=c$ and $f(b)=d$, the length of the linear function is less than the length of any other. (Or, in conventional but hopelessly muddled terminology: “A straight line is the shortest distance between two points”.)
blocks.translation: (c) 由此得出：在 $[a,b]$ 上所有满足 $f(a)=c$ 且 $f(b)=d$ 的函数 $f$ 中，线性函数的长度小于任何其他函数的长度。（或者，用传统却混乱得无可救药的说法：“直线是两点之间的最短距离”。）

blocks.source: (d) Suppose that $f'$ is bounded on $[a,b]$. If $P$ is any partition of $[a,b]$ show that
blocks.translation: (d) 假设 $f'$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上有界。如果 $P$ 是 $[a,b]$ 的任意分割，证明

blocks.source: $$L\left(\sqrt{1+(f')^2},P\right)\le\ell(f,P)\le U\left(\sqrt{1+(f')^2},P\right).$$
Hint: Use the Mean Value Theorem.
blocks.translation: 提示：使用中值定理。

blocks.source: (e) Why is $\sup\{L(\sqrt{1+(f')^2},P)\}\le\sup\{\ell(f,P)\}$? (This is easy.)
blocks.translation: (e) 为什么 $\sup\{L(\sqrt{1+(f')^2},P)\}\le\sup\{\ell(f,P)\}$？（这很容易。）

blocks.source: (f) Now show that $\sup\{\ell(f,P)\}\le\inf\{U(\sqrt{1+(f')^2},P)\}$, thereby proving that the length of $f$ on $[a,b]$ is $\int_a^b\sqrt{1+(f')^2}$, if $\sqrt{1+(f')^2}$ is integrable on $[a,b]$. Hint: It suffices to show that if $P'$ and $P''$ are any two partitions, then $\ell(f,P')\le U(\sqrt{1+(f')^2},P'')$. If $P$ contains the points of both $P'$ and $P''$, how does $\ell(f,P')$ compare to $\ell(f,P)$?
blocks.translation: (f) 现在证明 $\sup\{\ell(f,P)\}\le\inf\{U(\sqrt{1+(f')^2},P)\}$，从而证明：如果 $\sqrt{1+(f')^2}$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，那么 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上的长度为 $\int_a^b\sqrt{1+(f')^2}$。提示：只需证明，若 $P'$ 和 $P''$ 是任意两个分割，就有 $\ell(f,P')\le U(\sqrt{1+(f')^2},P'')$。如果 $P$ 包含 $P'$ 和 $P''$ 中的所有点，$\ell(f,P')$ 与 $\ell(f,P)$ 相比如何？

blocks.source: (g) Let $\mathcal L(x)$ be the length of the graph of $f$ on $[a,x]$, and let $d(x)$ be the length of the straight line segment from $(a,f(a))$ to $(x,f(x))$. Show that if $\sqrt{1+(f')^2}$ is integrable on $[a,b]$ and $f'$ is continuous at $a$ (i.e., if $\lim_{x\to a^+}f'(x)=f'(a)$), then
blocks.translation: (g) 设 $\mathcal L(x)$ 是 $f$ 的图像在 $[a,x]$ 上的长度，$d(x)$ 是从 $(a,f(a))$ 到 $(x,f(x))$ 的直线段的长度。证明：如果 $\sqrt{1+(f')^2}$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，并且 $f'$ 在 $a$ 处连续（即 $\lim_{x\to a^+}f'(x)=f'(a)$），那么

blocks.source: $$\lim_{x\to a^+}\frac{\mathcal L(x)}{d(x)}=1.$$
Hint: It will help to use a couple of Mean Value Theorems.
blocks.translation: 提示：使用两个中值定理会有帮助。

blocks.source: (h) In Figure 21, the part of the graph of $f$ between $\frac14$ and $\frac12$ is just half the size of the part between $\frac12$ and $1$, the part between $\frac18$ and $\frac14$ is just half the size of the part between $\frac14$ and $\frac12$, etc. Show that the conclusion of part (g) does not hold for this $f$.
blocks.translation: (h) 在图 21 中，$f$ 的图像介于 $\frac14$ 和 $\frac12$ 之间的部分，尺寸恰为介于 $\frac12$ 和 $1$ 之间部分的一半；介于 $\frac18$ 和 $\frac14$ 之间的部分，尺寸恰为介于 $\frac14$ 和 $\frac12$ 之间部分的一半，依此类推。证明，对这个 $f$，(g) 中的结论不成立。

blocks.source: A function $s$ defined on $[a,b]$ is called a **step function** if there is a partition $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ of $[a,b]$ such that $s$ is a constant on each $(t_{i-1},t_i)$ (the values of $s$ at $t_i$ may be arbitrary).
blocks.translation: 定义在 $[a,b]$ 上的函数 $s$ 称为**阶梯函数**，如果存在 $[a,b]$ 的一个分割 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$，使得 $s$ 在每个 $(t_{i-1},t_i)$ 上都是常数（$s$ 在 $t_i$ 处的值可以任意）。

blocks.source: (a) Prove that if $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$, then for any $\varepsilon>0$ there is a step
blocks.translation: (a) 证明：如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，那么对任意 $\varepsilon>0$，都存在阶梯

blocks.source: function $s_1\le f$ with $\int_a^b f-\int_a^b s_1<\varepsilon$, and also a step function $s_2\ge f$ with $\int_a^b s_2-\int_a^b f<\varepsilon$.
blocks.translation: 函数 $s_1\le f$ 满足 $\int_a^b f-\int_a^b s_1<\varepsilon$，也存在阶梯函数 $s_2\ge f$ 满足 $\int_a^b s_2-\int_a^b f<\varepsilon$。

blocks.source: (b) Suppose that for all $\varepsilon>0$ there are step functions $s_1\le f$ and $s_2\ge f$ such that $\int_a^b s_2-\int_a^b s_1<\varepsilon$. Prove that $f$ is integrable.
blocks.translation: (b) 假设对所有 $\varepsilon>0$，都存在阶梯函数 $s_1\le f$ 和 $s_2\ge f$，使得 $\int_a^b s_2-\int_a^b s_1<\varepsilon$。证明 $f$ 可积。

blocks.source: (c) Find a function $f$ which is not a step function, but which satisfies $\int_a^b f=L(f,P)$ for some partition $P$ of $[a,b]$.
blocks.translation: (c) 找出一个不是阶梯函数的函数 $f$，使它对于 $[a,b]$ 的某个分割 $P$ 满足 $\int_a^b f=L(f,P)$。

blocks.source: Prove that if $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$, then for any $\varepsilon>0$ there are continuous functions $g\le f\le h$ with $\int_a^b h-\int_a^b g<\varepsilon$. Hint: First get step functions with this property, and then continuous ones. A picture will help immensely.
blocks.translation: 证明：如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，那么对任意 $\varepsilon>0$，都存在连续函数 $g\le f\le h$，使得 $\int_a^b h-\int_a^b g<\varepsilon$。提示：先找出具有这一性质的阶梯函数，再找连续函数。画图会有极大的帮助。

blocks.source: (a) Show that if $s_1$ and $s_2$ are step functions on $[a,b]$, then $s_1+s_2$ is also.
blocks.translation: (a) 证明：如果 $s_1$ 和 $s_2$ 是 $[a,b]$ 上的阶梯函数，那么 $s_1+s_2$ 也是。

blocks.source: (b) Prove, without using Theorem 5, that $\int_a^b(s_1+s_2)=\int_a^b s_1+\int_a^b s_2$.
blocks.translation: (b) 不使用定理 5，证明 $\int_a^b(s_1+s_2)=\int_a^b s_1+\int_a^b s_2$。

blocks.source: (c) Use part (b) (and Problem 26) to give an alternative proof of Theorem 5.
blocks.translation: (c) 利用 (b)（以及习题 26），给出定理 5 的另一种证明。

blocks.source: Suppose that $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$. Prove that there is a number $x$ in $[a,b]$ such that $\int_a^x f=\int_x^b f$. Show by example that it is *not* always possible to choose $x$ to be in $(a,b)$.
blocks.translation: 设 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积。证明：在 $[a,b]$ 中存在一个数 $x$，使得 $\int_a^x f=\int_x^b f$。举例说明，*并非*总能把 $x$ 选在 $(a,b)$ 中。

blocks.source: The purpose of this problem is to show that if $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$, then $f$ must be continuous at many points in $[a,b]$.
blocks.translation: 本题的目的是证明：如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，那么 $f$ 必定在 $[a,b]$ 中的许多点连续。

blocks.source: (a) Let $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ be a partition of $[a,b]$ with $U(f,P)-L(f,P)<b-a$. Prove that for some $i$ we have $M_i-m_i<1$.
blocks.translation: (a) 设 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ 是 $[a,b]$ 的一个分割，满足 $U(f,P)-L(f,P)<b-a$。证明，对某个 $i$，有 $M_i-m_i<1$。

blocks.source: (b) Prove that there are numbers $a_1$ and $b_1$ with $a<a_1<b_1<b$ and $\sup\{f(x):a_1\le x\le b_1\}-\inf\{f(x):a_1\le x\le b_1\}<1$. (You can choose $[a_1,b_1]=[t_{i-1},t_i]$ from part (a) unless $i=1$ or $n$; and in these two cases a very simple device solves the problem.)
blocks.translation: (b) 证明：存在数 $a_1$ 和 $b_1$，满足 $a<a_1<b_1<b$ 且 $\sup\{f(x):a_1\le x\le b_1\}-\inf\{f(x):a_1\le x\le b_1\}<1$。（可以使用 (a) 中的分割，取 $[a_1,b_1]=[t_{i-1},t_i]$，除非 $i=1$ 或 $n$；在这两种情形中，一个非常简单的办法就能解决问题。）

blocks.source: (c) Prove that there are numbers $a_2$ and $b_2$ with $a_1<a_2<b_2<b_1$ and $\sup\{f(x):a_2\le x\le b_2\}-\inf\{f(x):a_2\le x\le b_2\}<\frac12$.
blocks.translation: (c) 证明：存在数 $a_2$ 和 $b_2$，满足 $a_1<a_2<b_2<b_1$ 且 $\sup\{f(x):a_2\le x\le b_2\}-\inf\{f(x):a_2\le x\le b_2\}<\frac12$。

blocks.source: (d) Continue in this way to find a sequence of intervals $I_n=[a_n,b_n]$ such that $\sup\{f(x):x\text{ in }I_n\}-\inf\{f(x):x\text{ in }I_n\}<1/n$. Apply the Nested Intervals Theorem (Problem 8-14) to find a point $x$ at which $f$ is continuous.
blocks.translation: (d) 继续这样做，找出一列区间 $I_n=[a_n,b_n]$，使得 $\sup\{f(x):x\text{ in }I_n\}-\inf\{f(x):x\text{ in }I_n\}<1/n$。应用闭区间套定理（习题 8-14），找出一个使 $f$ 连续的点 $x$。

blocks.source: (e) Prove that $f$ is continuous at infinitely many points in $[a,b]$.
blocks.translation: (e) 证明 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 中无穷多个点连续。

blocks.source: Let $f$ be integrable on $[a,b]$. Recall, from Problem 13, that $\int_a^b f\ge0$ if $f(x)\ge0$ for all $x$ in $[a,b]$.
blocks.translation: 设 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积。回想习题 13：如果对 $[a,b]$ 中所有 $x$ 都有 $f(x)\ge0$，那么 $\int_a^b f\ge0$。

blocks.source: (a) Give an example where $f(x)\ge0$ for all $x$, and $f(x)>0$ for some $x$ in $[a,b]$, and $\int_a^b f=0$.
blocks.translation: (a) 举一个例子，使得对所有 $x$ 都有 $f(x)\ge0$，对 $[a,b]$ 中某个 $x$ 有 $f(x)>0$，而且 $\int_a^b f=0$。

blocks.source: (b) Suppose $f(x)\ge0$ for all $x$ in $[a,b]$ and $f$ is continuous at $x_0$ in $[a,b]$ and $f(x_0)>0$. Prove that $\int_a^b f>0$. Hint: It suffices to find one lower sum $L(f,P)$ which is positive.
blocks.translation: (b) 假设对 $[a,b]$ 中所有 $x$ 都有 $f(x)\ge0$，并且 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 中的点 $x_0$ 处连续，且 $f(x_0)>0$。证明 $\int_a^b f>0$。提示：只需找出一个为正的下和 $L(f,P)$。

blocks.source: (c) Suppose $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$ and $f(x)>0$ for all $x$ in $[a,b]$. Prove that $\int_a^b f>0$. Hint: You will need Problem 30; indeed that was one reason for including Problem 30.
blocks.translation: (c) 假设 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，而且对 $[a,b]$ 中所有 $x$ 都有 $f(x)>0$。证明 $\int_a^b f>0$。提示：需要用到习题 30；这确实也是安排习题 30 的原因之一。

blocks.source: (a) Suppose that $f$ is continuous on $[a,b]$ and $\int_a^b fg=0$ for all continuous functions $g$ on $[a,b]$. Prove that $f=0$. (This is easy; there is an obvious $g$ to choose.)
blocks.translation: (a) 假设 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续，并且对 $[a,b]$ 上所有连续函数 $g$ 都有 $\int_a^b fg=0$。证明 $f=0$。（这很容易；有一个显而易见的 $g$ 可供选取。）

blocks.source: (b) Suppose $f$ is continuous on $[a,b]$ and that $\int_a^b fg=0$ for those continuous functions $g$ on $[a,b]$ which satisfy the extra conditions $g(a)=g(b)=0$. Prove that $f=0$. (This innocent looking fact is an important lemma in the calculus of variations; see reference [22] of the Suggested Reading.) Hint: Derive a contradiction from the assumption $f(x_0)>0$ or $f(x_0)<0$; the $g$ you pick will depend on the behavior of $f$ near $x_0$.
blocks.translation: (b) 假设 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上连续，并且对于 $[a,b]$ 上满足额外条件 $g(a)=g(b)=0$ 的所有连续函数 $g$，都有 $\int_a^b fg=0$。证明 $f=0$。（这个看似平常的事实，是变分法中的一个重要引理；见“推荐阅读”的参考文献 [22]。）提示：从假设 $f(x_0)>0$ 或 $f(x_0)<0$ 出发推出矛盾；你选取的 $g$ 将取决于 $f$ 在 $x_0$ 附近的表现。

blocks.source: Let $f(x)=x$ for $x$ rational and $f(x)=0$ for $x$ irrational.
blocks.translation: 当 $x$ 为有理数时，令 $f(x)=x$；当 $x$ 为无理数时，令 $f(x)=0$。

blocks.source: (a) Compute $L(f,P)$ for all partitions $P$ of $[0,1]$.
blocks.translation: (a) 对 $[0,1]$ 的所有分割 $P$，计算 $L(f,P)$。

blocks.source: (b) Find $\inf\{U(f,P):P\text{ a partition of }[0,1]\}$.
blocks.translation: (b) 求 $\inf\{U(f,P):P\text{ a partition of }[0,1]\}$。

blocks.source: Let $f(x)=0$ for irrational $x$, and $1/q$ if $x=p/q$ in lowest terms. Show that $f$ is integrable on $[0,1]$ and that $\int_0^1 f=0$. (Every lower sum is clearly $0$; you must figure out how to make upper sums small.)
blocks.translation: 当 $x$ 为无理数时，令 $f(x)=0$；当 $x=p/q$ 是最简分数时，令函数值为 $1/q$。证明 $f$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上可积，且 $\int_0^1 f=0$。（每个下和显然都是 $0$；你必须想办法使上和足够小。）

blocks.source: Find two functions $f$ and $g$ which are integrable, but whose composition $g\circ f$ is not. Hint: Problem 34 is relevant.
blocks.translation: 找出两个可积函数 $f$ 和 $g$，使其复合 $g\circ f$ 不可积。提示：习题 34 与此有关。

blocks.source: Let $f$ be a bounded function on $[a,b]$ and let $P$ be a partition of $[a,b]$. Let $M_i$ and $m_i$ have their usual meanings, and let $M_i'$ and $m_i'$ have the corresponding meanings for the function $|f|$.
blocks.translation: 设 $f$ 是 $[a,b]$ 上的有界函数，$P$ 是 $[a,b]$ 的一个分割。$M_i$ 和 $m_i$ 保持通常的含义，而 $M_i'$ 和 $m_i'$ 对函数 $|f|$ 具有相应的含义。

blocks.source: (a) Prove that $M_i'-m_i'\le M_i-m_i$.
blocks.translation: (a) 证明 $M_i'-m_i'\le M_i-m_i$。

blocks.source: (b) Prove that if $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$, then so is $|f|$.
blocks.translation: (b) 证明：若 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，则 $|f|$ 也可积。

blocks.source: (c) Prove that if $f$ and $g$ are integrable on $[a,b]$, then so are $\max(f,g)$ and $\min(f,g)$.
blocks.translation: (c) 证明：若 $f$ 和 $g$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，则 $\max(f,g)$ 和 $\min(f,g)$ 也可积。

blocks.source: (d) Prove that $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$ if and only if its “positive part” $\max(f,0)$ and its “negative part” $\min(f,0)$ are integrable on $[a,b]$.
blocks.translation: (d) 证明：$f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，当且仅当它的“正部” $\max(f,0)$ 和“负部” $\min(f,0)$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积。

blocks.source: Prove that if $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$, then
blocks.translation: 证明：如果 $f$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，那么

blocks.source: $$\left|\int_a^b f(t)dt\right|\le\int_a^b|f(t)|dt.$$
Hint: This follows easily from a certain string of inequalities; Problem 1-14 is relevant.
blocks.translation: 提示：这很容易由某一串不等式得到；习题 1-14 与此有关。

blocks.source: Suppose $f$ and $g$ are integrable on $[a,b]$ and $f(x),g(x)\ge0$ for all $x$ in $[a,b]$. Let $P$ be a partition of $[a,b]$. Let $M_i'$ and $m_i'$ denote the appropriate sup’s and inf’s for $f$, define $M_i''$ and $m_i''$ similarly for $g$, and define $M_i$ and $m_i$ similarly for $fg$.
blocks.translation: 设 $f$ 和 $g$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积，且对 $[a,b]$ 中所有 $x$ 都有 $f(x),g(x)\ge0$。设 $P$ 是 $[a,b]$ 的一个分割。用 $M_i'$ 和 $m_i'$ 分别表示 $f$ 对应的上确界和下确界；对 $g$ 类似地定义 $M_i''$ 和 $m_i''$；对 $fg$ 类似地定义 $M_i$ 和 $m_i$。

blocks.source: (a) Prove that $M_i\le M_i'M_i''$ and $m_i\ge m_i'm_i''$.
blocks.translation: (a) 证明 $M_i\le M_i'M_i''$ 且 $m_i\ge m_i'm_i''$。

blocks.source: (b) Show that
blocks.translation: (b) 证明

blocks.source: (c) Using the fact that $f$ and $g$ are bounded, so that $|f(x)|,|g(x)|\le M$ for $x$ in $[a,b]$, show that
blocks.translation: (c) 利用 $f$ 和 $g$ 有界这一事实，即对 $[a,b]$ 中的 $x$ 有 $|f(x)|,|g(x)|\le M$，证明

blocks.source: $$\begin{aligned}&U(fg,P)-L(fg,P)\\&\quad\le M\left\{\sum_{i=1}^n[M_i'-m_i'](t_i-t_{i-1})+\sum_{i=1}^n[M_i''-m_i''](t_i-t_{i-1})\right\}.\end{aligned}$$
(d) Prove that $fg$ is integrable.
blocks.translation: (d) 证明 $fg$ 可积。

blocks.source: (e) Now eliminate the restriction that $f(x),g(x)\ge0$ for $x$ in $[a,b]$.
blocks.translation: (e) 现在去掉“对 $[a,b]$ 中的 $x$ 有 $f(x),g(x)\ge0$”这一限制。

blocks.source: Suppose that $f$ and $g$ are integrable on $[a,b]$. The *Cauchy-Schwarz inequality* states that
blocks.translation: 设 $f$ 和 $g$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上可积。*柯西–施瓦茨不等式*断言

blocks.source: $$\left(\int_a^b fg\right)^2\le\left(\int_a^b f^2\right)\left(\int_a^b g^2\right).$$
(a) Show that the Schwarz inequality is a special case of the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality.
blocks.translation: (a) 证明，施瓦茨不等式是柯西–施瓦茨不等式的一个特例。

blocks.source: (b) Give three proofs of the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality by imitating the proofs of the Schwarz inequality in Problem 2-21. (The last one will take some imagination.)
blocks.translation: (b) 模仿习题 2-21 中施瓦茨不等式的证明，给出柯西–施瓦茨不等式的三个证明。（最后一个需要发挥一些想象力。）

blocks.source: (c) If equality holds, is it necessarily true that $f=\lambda g$ for some $\lambda$? What if $f$ and $g$ are continuous?
blocks.translation: (c) 如果等号成立，是否必定存在某个 $\lambda$ 使得 $f=\lambda g$？如果 $f$ 和 $g$ 连续呢？

blocks.source: (d) Prove that $\left(\int_0^1 f\right)^2\le\left(\int_0^1 f^2\right)$. Is this result true if $0$ and $1$ are replaced by $a$ and $b$?
blocks.translation: (d) 证明 $\left(\int_0^1 f\right)^2\le\left(\int_0^1 f^2\right)$。如果把 $0$ 和 $1$ 换成 $a$ 和 $b$，这个结果还成立吗？

blocks.source: Suppose that $f$ is integrable on $[0,x]$ for all $x>0$ and $\lim_{x\to\infty}f(x)=a$. Prove that
blocks.translation: 假设对于所有 $x>0$，$f$ 都在 $[0,x]$ 上可积，并且 $\lim_{x\to\infty}f(x)=a$。证明

blocks.source: $$\lim_{x\to\infty}\frac1x\int_0^x f(t)dt=a.$$

Hint: The condition $\lim_{x\to\infty}f(x)=a$ implies that $f(t)$ is close to $a$ for $t\ge$ some $N$. This means that $\int_N^{N+M}f(t)dt$ is close to $Ma$. If $M$ is large in comparison to $N$, then $Ma/(N+M)$ is close to $a$.
blocks.translation: 提示：条件 $\lim_{x\to\infty}f(x)=a$ 意味着，当 $t\ge$ 某个 $N$ 时，$f(t)$ 接近 $a$。这意味着 $\int_N^{N+M}f(t)dt$ 接近 $Ma$。如果 $M$ 相对于 $N$ 很大，那么 $Ma/(N+M)$ 就接近 $a$。

blocks.source: ## APPENDIX. RIEMANN SUMS
blocks.translation: ## 附录　黎曼和

blocks.source: Suppose that $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ is a partition of $[a,b]$, and that for each $i$ we choose some point $x_i$ in $[t_{i-1},t_i]$. Then we clearly have
blocks.translation: 设 $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ 是 $[a,b]$ 的一个分割，并且对每个 $i$，都在 $[t_{i-1},t_i]$ 中选取某个点 $x_i$。那么显然有

blocks.source: $$L(f,P)\le\sum_{i=1}^n f(x_i)(t_i-t_{i-1})\le U(f,P).$$

Any sum $\sum_{i=1}^n f(x_i)(t_i-t_{i-1})$ is called a *Riemann sum* of $f$ for $P$. Figure 1 shows the geometric interpretation of a Riemann sum; it is the total area of $n$ rectangles that lie partly below the graph of $f$ and partly above it. Because of the arbitrary way in which the heights of the rectangles have been picked, we can’t say for sure whether a particular Riemann sum is less than or greater than the integral $\int_a^b f(x)dx$. But it does seem that the overlaps shouldn’t matter too much; if the bases of all the rectangles are narrow enough, then the Riemann sum ought to be close to the integral. The following theorem states this precisely.
blocks.translation: 任意和式 $\sum_{i=1}^n f(x_i)(t_i-t_{i-1})$ 都称为 $f$ 关于 $P$ 的一个*黎曼和*。图 1 给出了黎曼和的几何解释：它是 $n$ 个矩形的总面积，这些矩形一部分位于 $f$ 的图像下方，一部分位于图像上方。由于矩形的高度是任意选取的，我们无法确定某个具体的黎曼和究竟小于还是大于积分 $\int_a^b f(x)dx$。不过，这些重叠似乎不应有太大影响；如果所有矩形的底都足够窄，那么黎曼和应当接近积分。下面的定理精确表述了这一点。

blocks.source: **THEOREM 1** Suppose that $f$ is integrable on $[a,b]$. Then for every $\varepsilon>0$ there is some $\delta>0$ such that, if $P=\{t_0,\ldots,t_n\}$ is any partition of $[a,b]$ with all lengths $t_i-t_{i-1}<\delta$, then

blocks.translation: 这对在 $[t_{i-1},t_i]$ 中选取 $x_i$ 所形成的任意黎曼和都成立。

blocks.source: **PROOF** Since the Riemann sum and the integral both lie between $L(f,P)$ and $U(f,P)$, this amounts to showing that for any given $\varepsilon$ we can make $U(f,P)-L(f,P)<\varepsilon$ by choosing a $\delta$ such that $U(f,P)-L(f,P)<\varepsilon$ for any partition with all lengths $t_i-t_{i-1}<\delta$.

blocks.source: The moral of this tale is that anything which looks like a good approximation to an integral really is, provided that all the lengths $t_i-t_{i-1}$ of the intervals in the partition are small enough.
